notes: Manufacturer's own spec-sheet URL (luxul.com/.../lux-spec-xms-2624p.ashx) now 301-redirects to the generic legrandav.com/luxul landing page (Luxul was absorbed into Legrand AV), so it could not be fetched directly. Used Markertek's detailed retailer spec table as primary source, cross-checked against the Luxul AMS-2624P Quick Install Manual (via ManualsLib) and AV-iQ/Full Compass datasheet listings, which agree on port counts, PoE budget, and power input. All 26 RJ45/SFP ports plus the console port are on the rear panel (front panel carries only LEDs and a mode button). RJ45/SFP combo ports 25-26 are shared pairs (using the SFP disables the paired RJ45, or vice versa) - modeled here as two separate bidirectional RJ45 uplink ports; the shared SFP cage alternative is not separately listed. Console port is an RJ45-style serial console (Cisco-style pinout, needs RJ45-to-DB9 adapter cable per Luxul documentation) - modeled as rs232 over an rj45 connector shape is not available in the enum, so it is omitted from the port list as a physical DE-9/RS232 equivalent isn't directly confirmed and would misrepresent the connector. Power inlet is an internal switching supply, 100-240VAC 50/60Hz, with a detachable "Power Cord" (US cord ships in the box) - consistent with a standard IEC C14 inlet, though the datasheet does not explicitly name "IEC C14"; modeled as connector "iec" (C13/C14 family) with medium confidence. No grade fields set for RJ45 data ports since the datasheets state "Gigabit"/1000Mbps but do not use an explicit "1G" spec-sheet callout beyond implied eth-1g, which is included since 1000BASE-T/Gigabit is unambiguous. SFP cage speed not separately confirmed (likely 1G SFP, not confirmed as 2.5G/10G) so no grade set for the SFP alternative use.
